changelog.summary: Fixes the blocking first-run defects in 0.8.0-alpha.4: completedSteps now migrates from numeric indexes to canonical step ids without data loss; the wizard runs source discovery before planning; plan failures and empty filter results are explained with exact codes and exclusion counts; date ranges are inclusive; capability objects render readably; empty plans cannot be approved; and APP vs WEBSITE destination safety is explained before publication.

desktop.changelog: Wizard/plan/UX fix release. Canonical completedSteps ids with an idempotent numeric-index migration, automatic source discovery, explicit SOURCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED and plan failure details, per-filter empty-plan diagnostics, inclusive end-of-day date ranges, object-safe capability rendering, disabled approval for empty plans, and APP/WEBSITE safety warnings. Publisher and CMS sources are unchanged.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Generic CMS artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.3 owner-Admin fix.
